168	    def _derive_verbs(self):
169	        src = read(self.root, "scripts/db.py")
170	        tree = ast.parse(src)
171	        funcs = {n.name: n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef)}
172	        sqlw = re.compile(r'\b(INSERT\s+(?:OR\s+\w+\s+)?INTO|UPDATE|DELETE\s+FROM)\s+"?(\w+)"?', re.I)
173	        real = set(self.tables)
174	        def strings(node):
175	            for n in ast.walk(node):
176	                if isinstance(n, ast.Constant) and isinstance(n.value, str): yield n.value
177	                elif isinstance(n, ast.JoinedStr):
178	                    yield "".join(v.value if isinstance(v, ast.Constant) else "{}" for v in n.values)
179	        def writes(fn, seen=None, depth=0):
180	            seen = seen or set(); out = {}
181	            if fn.name in seen or depth > 3: return out
182	            seen.add(fn.name)
183	            for s in strings(fn):
184	                for m in sqlw.finditer(s):
185	                    op, t = m.group(1).split()[0].upper(), m.group(2)
186	                    if t in real: out.setdefault(t, set()).add(op)       # prose words ('that', 'below') are not tables
187	            for n in ast.walk(fn):
188	                if isinstance(n, ast.Call) and isinstance(n.func, ast.Name) and n.func.id in funcs and n.func.id != fn.name:
189	                    for t, ops in writes(funcs[n.func.id], seen, depth + 1).items(): out.setdefault(t, set()).update(ops)
190	            return out
191	        refus = lambda fn: sum(1 for n in ast.walk(fn) if isinstance(n, ast.Raise) and isinstance(n.exc, ast.Call)
192	                               and getattr(n.exc.func, "id", getattr(n.exc.func, "attr", "")) == "Refusal")
193	        dispatch = {}
194	        for n in ast.walk(funcs["main"]):
195	            if isinstance(n, ast.If) and isinstance(n.test, ast.Compare) and isinstance(n.test.left, ast.Attribute) \
196	                    and n.test.left.attr == "command":
197	                cmp_ = n.test.comparators[0]
198	                names = [cmp_.value] if isinstance(cmp_, ast.Constant) else [e.value for e in getattr(cmp_, "elts", []) if isinstance(e, ast.Constant)]
199	                called = []
200	                for st in n.body:
201	                    for c in ast.walk(st):
202	                        if isinstance(c, ast.Call) and isinstance(c.func, ast.Name) and c.func.id in funcs: called.append(c.func.id)
203	                for v in names:
204	                    dispatch.setdefault(v, list(dict.fromkeys(called)))
205	        self.verbs = {}
206	        for v in re.findall(r'add_parser\(\s*"([^"]+)"', src):
207	            w, r, fs = {}, 0, dispatch.get(v, [])
208	            for f in fs:
209	                for t, ops in writes(funcs[f]).items(): w.setdefault(t, set()).update(ops)
210	                r += refus(funcs[f])
211	            self.verbs[v] = dict(functions=fs, writes={t: sorted(o) for t, o in sorted(w.items())}, refusals=r)
212	        self.writers = collections.defaultdict(list)
213	        for v, d in self.verbs.items():
214	            for t in d["writes"]: self.writers[t].append(v)

220	    def unwritable_set(self):
221	        """(child.col -> parent) NOT NULL FKs into an emptied table, with whether a verb writes the parent too."""
222	        out = []
223	        for f in self.unwritable_fk:
224	            vc = set(self.writers.get(f["child"], [])); vp = set(self.writers.get(f["parent"], []))
225	            out.append(dict(f, verbs_child=sorted(vc), parent_written_by_same_verb=sorted(vc & vp)))
226	        return out

228	    def no_writer_tables(self):
229	        return sorted(t for t in self.tables if t not in self.writers)

238	            info[v] = dict(reads=reads, stages=stages, crosses=len(stages) > 1, rows=n)

# Adversarial pass: steps 0.4, 0.5, 0.6 (a7d56c9..3a745d1 in /home/user/guidebook-review-p0)

All commands were run in the worktree or on copies under `/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-guidebook/f366a537-569c-50d0-a2d1-f74dc994928a/scratchpad/antagonist3/` (overlay `repo/` = symlinks to the worktree plus a copied `workplan/`; `fake/` for the transcript-anchor reproduction). Nothing in the worktree or in /home/user/guidebook was written. Every count below was computed in this pass.

## Findings, worst first

### F1 (CONFIRMED, HIGH) — 0.6: `--check`'s new EXAMINED line counts the cited set, not what was verified; a gate wired to nothing still prints 465 and passes, and `--selftest` cannot tell
**Artifact:** `/home/user/guidebook-review-p0/workplan/pipeline-state-graph/build_graph.py:588-590`.
**Claim:** "--check: 0 failures, the cited set is printed as an EXAMINED line next to the atom total" (commit aa70234); `EXAMINED: 465 atoms cited ... (quote found verbatim)`.
**Failure case:** line 590 computes `len(cited & set(atoms))` from the *input* set, independent of what `verify_atoms(..., only=...)` actually examined. In the scratch overlay I changed line 588 to `only=set()` (the gate examining nothing) and ran `--check`: it printed `EXAMINED: 465 atoms cited ... (quote found verbatim)`, `0 failure(s)`; `--selftest` then reported `EXAMINED: 15 mutation tests`, all PASS. No mutation test exercises the `only=` path: tests (a), (a2), (l) call `verify_atoms({k: ...})` directly with the default `only=None`, so they prove the function, never the gate `check_all` runs. This is CLAUDE.md §5(a) exactly: a PASS whose EXAMINED figure does not describe its subject.
**Command:** `sed -i 's/only=cited); fails += bad/only=set()); fails += bad/' <overlay>/workplan/pipeline-state-graph/build_graph.py && python3 <overlay>/workplan/pipeline-state-graph/build_graph.py --check; python3 ... --selftest` (output in `/tmp/claude-0/.../tasks/bxsfpo6kt.output`, block B).
**Gate that should have caught it:** `build_graph.py --selftest` — it ran (15 subjects) but none of its subjects is the `only=` gate. No registry check reads this file (W4 says so; `run_checks.py --list` confirms it is unregistered).

### F2 (CONFIRMED, HIGH) — 0.6: `--selftest` certifies "mutated quotes on 5 random atoms are caught (5/5)" on five atoms `--check` no longer verifies
**Artifact:** `build_graph.py:719-725` (test a2); seed 7 sample = `EVI-431, ENT-259, OPI-077, WRK-227, DRS-144`.
**Claim:** the selftest "proves the checks can fail" (docstring line 695) and the commit says "--selftest 15/15".
**Failure case:** all five sampled atoms are outside the cited set (computed: `cited` = 465 of 2692; none of the five is in it). I mutated EVI-431's quote to `zzz this quote is not in any source zzz` in `atoms-evi.jsonl` on the overlay: `--check` → `0 failure(s)`; `--selftest` → `PASS mutated quotes on 5 random atoms are caught (5/5)`. The selftest and the check are two names for one function, with different subjects; the selftest's PASS is not evidence about the gate (lens L3).
**Command:** overlay block A in `/tmp/claude-0/.../tasks/bxsfpo6kt.output`; cited-set computation in `/tmp/claude-0/.../scratchpad/antagonist3/atomcheck.py`.

### F3 (CONFIRMED, MEDIUM) — 0.6: the grep surfaces publish unverified atoms with no mark; shrinking the cited set hides a bad quote and a bogus line, as W9 intends, but nothing downstream says so
**Artifact:** `build_graph.py:970-973` (ATOMS.tsv / OPEN-QUESTIONS.tsv / AMBIGUITIES.tsv writers); `workplan/pipeline-state-graph/ATOMS.tsv` header = `id status modality speaker date source stages subject claim enforcement` (no cited/verified column); README.md:14 ("flat views for grep").
**Failure case:** CLM-038 is cited by exactly one conflict, C-002. On the overlay I deleted C-002 and set CLM-038's quote to `zzz not in CLAUDE.md zzz`, source `CLAUDE.md:9999`: `--check` → `EXAMINED: 460 atoms cited`, `49 conflicts`, `0 failure(s)`. A regenerate would then write `CLM-038 ACTIVE ... CLAUDE.md:9999` into ATOMS.tsv as a grep hit indistinguishable from a verified one. Scale today: 2227 of 2692 atoms are now unverified records; 21 of the 51 CLAUDE.md atoms are among them (`CLAUDE.md atoms: 51 cited: 30`), including CLM-053 and CLM-056 — CLM-056 is one of the two atoms 0.5 re-anchored, and 0.6 then stopped checking it. The plan's Phase 1 schedules repeated CLAUDE.md "owner merge" edits; each can silently stale those 21 lines/quotes with nothing going red.
**Command:** overlay block C in `bxsfpo6kt.output`; `head -1 workplan/pipeline-state-graph/ATOMS.tsv`.

### F4 (CONFIRMED, MEDIUM) — 0.5: the measuring command is printed across a line break; pasted as it reads it measures the wrong thing and errors
**Artifact:** `/home/user/guidebook-review-p0/CLAUDE.md:511-512`.
**Claim:** "Measure: `git diff --shortstat origin/main -- scripts tools schemas .github skills ':!scripts/migrations'` ⏎ `':!tools/*.html'`. Enforced by review, not by a check."
**Failure case:** the backticked command wraps, so the second pathspec lands on its own line. Executing the two lines exactly as printed in the worktree: line 1 → `6 files changed, 15 insertions(+), 12 deletions(-)` (four regenerated `tools/*.html` dashboards included); line 2 → `bash: :!tools/*.html: No such file or directory`. The one-line form gives `2 files changed, 10 insertions(+), 7 deletions(-)`. The rule's only enforcement is a reviewer running this; the printed form gives a different number. (The pathspec itself works: `:!tools/*.html` did exclude all four html files in the one-line run.)
**Command:** `bash -c "git diff --shortstat origin/main -- scripts tools schemas .github skills ':!scripts/migrations'
  ':!tools/*.html'"` in the worktree.

### F5 (CONFIRMED measurement; PLAUSIBLE violation at PR time, MEDIUM) — 0.5: the branch that introduces the net-negative rule is net-positive by its own measure
**Artifact:** `CLAUDE.md:508-512`; branch `stack/0.4-transcripts-anchor` (contains 3a745d1; no open PR for it as of this pass — `gh api repos/jordanelias/guidebook/pulls?state=open` returns none with that head; PR #172 is `closed`).

The 0.4–0.6 subject itself is +1/−1 (net 0, as a55d9e3 claims). A PR opened from this branch raises the total unless its description names the exception and what db.py's lines replace; none of the four commit bodies says so.
**Command:** as above, plus `git diff --shortstat a7d56c9 -- scripts tools schemas .github skills ':!scripts/migrations' ':!tools/*.html'` → `1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)`.

### F6 (CONFIRMED, MEDIUM) — 0.5: `tools/data_atlas_template.html` is hand-written input that the rewritten bullet classes as generated and regenerable
**Artifact:** `CLAUDE.md:458-460`; `tools/data_atlas.py:465` (`tpl = (ROOT / "tools/data_atlas_template.html").read_text(...)`).
**Claim:** "Don't hand-edit generated output (… `tools/*.html`) — regenerate `tools/*.html` … with `scripts/regenerate_derived.sh`".

The 3a745d1 follow-up corrected `audits/` for the same sentence and missed this.
**Command:** `ls tools/*.html; grep -n 'template' tools/data_atlas.py; grep -nE 'DEFAULT_OUT|OUT =' tools/*.py`.

**Artifact:** `CLAUDE.md:391-392`: "`populations` IS the identity lens (`base_taxonomy_identity`)".
